test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If Sin θ = 5/6, the value of Cot θ ⋅ Sin θ ⋅ Cos θ is _________.
solution:
Given

Sin θ = 5/6

Concept used

cot θ = cosθ / sinθ

cos θ = B/H

P2 + B2 = H2

Calculation

Cot θ ⋅ Sin θ ⋅ Cos θ = cosθ / sinθ × Sin θ × Cos θ

Cot θ ⋅ Sin θ ⋅ Cos θ = cos²θ

Sin θ = 5/6

52 + B2 = 62

B2 = 36 - 25 = 11

cos2θ = B2/H2

cos2θ = 11/36

**∴ The answer is 11/36.**
